what: Proposed delegate timeout uses only 2× SUBPROCESS_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SEC per cycle but _run_cycle runs verify_job_locally once per classified.fixable job, each with default subprocess timeout
scenario_or_breakage: Multi-job CI failures (e.g. python-lint plus python-tests shards) can still exceed the per-cycle budget; parent kills the delegate mid-verify and OOS delegate-timeout fix is only partial
suggested_fix: Extend the formula with a static verify ceiling tied to existing config (e.g. multiply verify budget by a documented max slots constant) or document and test the single-verify assumption explicitly
